body.p: The claims were amended in accordance with the amendments above. All of the amendments are fully supported by the specification, claims, and figures as originally filed. No new matter is believed or intended to be involved.

In the Office Action, Claim 14 is objected to because of informalities.1 Claim 14 has been amended to make the correction suggested by the Examiner. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the objection.

Claims 1, 5-6, 9-11, 15-19, 21, 32-33, 35-36, and 40 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being obvious over U.S. Patent Publication No. 2019/0133689 ("Johnson") in view of U.S. Patent Publication No. 20 19/0262084 ("Roh") and U.S. Patent Publication No. 2017/0010620 ("Watabe"). 2 Claims 12-14 and 22-24 were rejected under 35 U.S.C. §103 as being obvious over Johnson in view of Roh and Watabe and further in view of U.S. Patent Publication No. 20 18/0078439 ("Cagle").3 Of the rejected claims, claims 1 and 19 are independent.

Applicant appreciates the indication in the Office Action that claims 25-29, 31, and 37-38 were allowed, and that claims 34 and 39 recite allowable subject matter.4 Claims 1 and 19 have each been amended based on features of allowable claim 34. New claim 41 has been added based on features of allowable claim 39. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the objections and an indication of allowance for all claims.

Applicant expressly reserves all rights and arguments with respect to distinctions not explicitly noted herein. To the extent that the amendments constitute a narrowing of the claims, such narrowing of the claims should not be construed as an admission as to the merits of the prior rejections. To the extent that any particular statement or argument by the Office in the pending Office Action has not been explicitly addressed herein, the same should not be construed as an acquiescence or admission by the Applicant that such statements or arguments by the Office are accurate or proper.

Based on the foregoing, all pending claims are in a condition for allowance. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and an early notice of allowance. Should the Examiner wish to discuss the amendments or arguments made herein, Applicant invites the Examiner to contact the undersigned at (415) 857-8309 or via e-mail at akhouzam@fbtlaw.com.

The Commissioner for Patents is hereby authorized to charge any deficiency, including any fees required for an extension of time not already paid for or any other required fees not already paid for, or to credit any overpayment of fees, to Frost Brown Todd LLP Deposit Account No. 06-2226.
